n: Wekiva High crowd counting and edge detection plan
t: A four day AP Computer Science Principles plan on computer vision and edge detection.
steps: Find the plan on the UCF CRCV Research Experience for Teachers page.
Download the lesson plan and the poster.
Prepare the 13 slide and 16 slide presentations.
Laminate a crowd photo divided into 10 squares.
Ask IT about Nearpod and the crowd counting software.
